issue_detail.value: Run eleven's lanes turn the full suite red in five tests the per-commit runs never selected
The report's Dollar cost row does not carry the lower-bound label for a Grok figure priced from a session total, so a lower bound reads as exact - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
A project that replaces grok-4.7 under pricing.models loses grok-4.7@long-context from its own table, so run_state.usd prices only part of the reading - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
A re-close after a reopen whose meter cannot be read drops the first window, takes no reading and says nothing on the page - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

BG1005 makes a criterion whose pytest target partly skips on the running machine read red, including Done criteria the release gate re-runs, and the count is not measured - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

A Verify line with its own -q makes pytest run at -qq with no summary, so a partial skip is stamped pass, and -s and an unpinned _PYTEST_SKIP_NODE add edge cases - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
sprint lane return --agent refuses a multi-unit lane, so a multi-unit lane's builder is never priced per unit - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
lane land commits and lands the code, then refuses a self-check missing a required surface, when the builder can no longer be resumed - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
lane accept takes --reviewer as free text, so a carried unit's re-review under the wrong id strands an APPROVE that only an operator supersession retires - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
lane run accepts a home-isolated unit and hands its worktree builder the main-checkout brief, and 'Isolation: no home' reads as home - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
A builder's mutation probe in a scratch copy of the tests runs without the repo-root conftest.py, so without HOME confinement - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
lane land's rebase uses --empty=keep --reapply-cherry-picks, so a commit a builder made that main already holds becomes an empty commit - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
A Ctrl-C during lane run's 2 s kill grace drops the SIGKILL that follows, so a SIGTERM-ignoring child stages after the run, and nothing pins that SIGKILL - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
CI's lint.yml sets up Node 20 while markdownlint-cli and markdownlint declare node >=22, so the gap is invisible until a dependency uses a Node 22 API - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
BG1420 did not converge in review: round 2 REJECT findings - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
A nested run_verifier caller's own verifier can outlive it, because both levels wait the same one second grace and Ctrl-C leaks the inner verifier - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
Two more group-kill helpers duplicate verify_ac's, one closure in mutation.py and one in verify_ac._run_phase - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
The changelog's 6.3.0 text and the BG1112 fragment still over-state what the group kill does - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
This repo's own AGENTS.md lacks the template's 'Integrate continuously' line, so validate.py check warns here - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
Timing tests fail under parallel load: test_status GatherPerformanceTests read 4.9 s against a 3 s limit and a verify_ac criterion failed once at load 8.6 - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
test_cli_grammar RealTreeMarkerTests copies the whole tree into /tmp and fails with EDQUOT on a small tmpfs - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
An sdlc_md root-discovery test fails when TMPDIR is inside a repository, because it assumes its temporary directory lies outside any project - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
sdlc_md.extract_field reads an empty field on into the next line and returns '>', and two is_swallowed_run branches are unpinned - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
test_lean_tracked_run_record test_this_repos_signed_reports_check_in_a_clean_clone fails in a harness worktree - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

prices and token_meters have untested edges: `_rates()` falls back to an empty table, `_list`'s long-context pop, a true threshold read as 1, and `book()` splits labelled lower bound - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
The tool-call budget in a multi-unit lane brief is printed once per unit and nothing states the lane's total - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
BG1190's unpinned reap and BG1262/BG1261's watchdog SIGKILL after its grace are covered by no test - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
The BG1333 integration rule counts as present if 'Integrate continuously' appears anywhere in AGENTS.md, so a sentence negating it passes - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
retro's new `supplied` guard and its `declined` list have no tests - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
critic.py record splits a verdict's ISSUES at every semicolon, so a semicolon inside one finding becomes an untagged finding and the record is refused - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
Nothing pins critic's 'live rows' filter, the carried-refusal wording or the stacked-criterion naming, and the BG1339 rejoinder path guards are untested - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

sprint lane land's hook-refusal text and module docstring say the worktree and main are as they were, which is untrue after the replay, and _discard_own_artefacts is untested - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

BG1330's re-pointed clean-run test lost its known-issues assertion, unpriced_units' filter is untested, and lane land with no run open names lane return's --tokens flag - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
The unpriced-gap remedy 'lane return --units <id> --agent A' cannot work after the close - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
templates/agents/sdlc-builder.md and its pinned .claude/agents copy still tell a builder to run verify_ac without --dry-run - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
The BG1262/BG1261 changelog headline is too broad, the help line reads as SIGTERM-first for every death of sprint.py, and lanes._reaping sends SIGKILL first - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
No test pins the line number verify_ac's lint prints - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
help/verify.md's exit-3 row in the revert-check table leaves out git failing to read the base blob - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
verify_ac's revert check reads a missing runner binary as red rather than as no verdict - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
No test pins verify_ac's class and module skip-mark check on the decorator's name - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
file_finding writes a title with bare underscores into the bug heading and index, which markdownlint then refuses as emphasis - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
A bare sprint close runs its whole pre-flight report before scaffolding the retro, so the scaffold takes many minutes - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
